card.statement: The group $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is Langlands dual to $G$; more precisely the root datum of $\widetilde{G}_{\mathbf{k}}$ with respect to $T^{\vee}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is dual to the root datum of $G$ with respect to $T$.
card.label: Theorem 9.8

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
